answer: Jade Ledge Guardianship enforces identity by requiring each new operator to plant a token on a physical ledge, with a $500 daily cost to maintain the ledge garden in a protected meadow. An attacker must pay per-identity to sustain each ledge, making mass sybil creation prohibitively expensive. The ledge and meadow ritual ties digital identity to verifiable physical presence, while the jade token serves as a non-transferable stake.
